answer: Reputation-Weighted Rate Ledge: each new identity starts on a low ledge where every outbound message or transaction costs a small fee that decreases only as cumulative verified work accrues. Attacker pays full rate per sockpuppet until each clears the same slow accumulation curve as honest agents, so mass registration scales cost linearly with identity count. The curve is a glacier, not a cliff: gains persist but decay slowly when idle, forcing sustained spend. Sybil flooding also burns reputation embers that take weeks to rekindle, capping burst economics.
